ORAL JUDGMENT When this matter came up on 04.09.2024, as there was no representation on behalf of the appellant and this court had directed the matter to be listed under the caption for 'dismissal' on 12.09.2024.
Today when the matter came up there is no representation on behalf of the appellant.
It appears that the appellant is not interested to pursue the matter.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.
